sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Green Rain Drop Glass Bangles (12 Piece)
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Description:
Add a touch of timeless elegance to your ethnic wear with this stunning set of emerald green glass bangles, beautifully embellished with delicate golden bead accents. Crafted from high-quality glass, each bangle radiates a rich green hue, making it the perfect accessory for sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, and festive indo-western outfits.
Designed for comfort and durability, these bangles are lightweight and suitable for daily wear, festivals, weddings, and parties. The intricate golden bead work enhances the vibrant color, creating a sparkling effect that elevates your look. Ideal for pairing with bridal jewelry sets or gifting on special occasions, this bangle set is a must-have for every jewelry lover.
Key Features:
- Premium emerald green glass bangles with golden bead detailing
- Traditional handcrafted finish for a classic ethnic look
- Lightweight, comfortable, and durable for everyday and festive occasions
- Enhances wedding, festive, and party outfits
- Thoughtful gift for birthdays, weddings, festivals, and celebrations
- Complements all types of Indian and fusion attire
